Mercenary.hpFromClass: Set by the class's health track and your level.

Deck.title: Modifier Deck
Deck.reshufflePending: A Critical or Null was drawn: the deck will be reshuffled at the end of the round
Deck.rebuildConfirm: Rebuild this Modifier Deck from the base deck and your ticked perks? The discard pile is shuffled back in. Bless and Curse cards are kept.
Deck.notReady: This Modifier Deck has not been created yet. A GM must be connected to create it.

Draw.tie: Both cards are equivalent but differ in effects: the GM decides which one applies.

Test.title: Attribute Test
Test.resistBackgroundHint: Resisting costs a Background, which gives no bonus here.
Test.skillHint: Expend a ready Skill to add half its level (rounded up). Explain how it helps!
Test.razorsEdgeHint: A Skill expended on a Razor's Edge test also grants advantage.

Attack.title: Attack
Attack.bonusHint: Sum of +X / -X attack effects (e.g. +1 if the target is Poisoned).
Attack.wardHint: Halves the damage, rounding the reduction up. Applied last, after Shield.
Attack.poisonedHint: +1 attack, applied with the other attack bonuses.

Background.bonusHint: Expend to add to an Attribute test:

Rest.title: Rest
Rest.quickBreathHint: End of scene: optionally expend remaining Skills to heal 3 each, then recover expended powers and Backgrounds, and remove conditions.
Rest.fullRestHint: Recover all HP and every power (even lost), remove conditions and Bless/Curse, then choose your Skills.
Rest.quickBreathPrompt: You have {count} ready Skill(s) left. You may expend them to heal 3 each before recovering.

Notify.noGM: A GM must be connected to do this.
Notify.notDeckOwner: You do not own this Modifier Deck.
Notify.deckEmpty: Not enough cards in the Modifier Deck.

cardFace.name: Modifier card faces
cardFace.hint: How modifier cards are displayed for you: Gloomhaven-style faces, or the matching playing card (for groups using a poker deck).

mercenaryCount.name: Mercenaries present (M)
mercenaryCount.hint: Used for nemesis stats and Threat maximums. 0 = count the player-owned mercenaries.

Perk.none: No perks yet. Add one and enter its cards from your class's perk list.
Perk.descriptionPlaceholder: e.g. Replace a −1 with a +0 Wound
Perk.codesHint: Each box below is one checkbox of the perk. Write cards as playing-card codes: 7♥ or 7H, 10S, AC, RJ / BJ for jokers. Separate several cards with spaces or +.

issue.invalidCode: {perk} (box {box}): "{code}" is not a valid card code.
issue.missingCard: {perk} (box {box}): {code} is not in the deck, so it can't be removed.
issue.duplicateCard: {perk} (box {box}): {code} is already in the deck. Groups using a poker deck can't have it twice.

import.title: Import perks
import.hint: Choose a JSON file of perks (one class file, for example). Perks whose name already exists on this mercenary are skipped.

Condition.resist: Resist: test this Attribute, expending a Background (it gives no bonus). TN = the enemy's move + attack.

bless.name: Bless
bless.hint: Shuffles a Bless card into the Modifier Deck (max 6). It counts as a Critical.

curse.name: Curse
curse.hint: Shuffles a Curse card into the Modifier Deck (max 6). It counts as a Null. Test UN to resist.

invisible.name: Invisible
invisible.hint: Enemies can't target you, and opposing tokens (Friendly vs Hostile) can't see your token. Combat: until the end of your next turn. Exploration: until the end of the scene.

regenerate.name: Regenerate
regenerate.hint: Heal 1 at the start of each of your turns, before Wound. Lasts until you take damage.

safeguard.name: Safeguard
safeguard.hint: Prevents the next negative condition you would gain.

strengthen.name: Strengthen
strengthen.hint: Your actions gain advantage. Combat: until the end of your next turn. Exploration: one action.

ward.name: Ward
ward.hint: Halves the next damage you suffer (reduction rounded up), applied after everything else.

immobilize.name: Immobilize
immobilize.hint: You can't perform movement abilities (forced movement still works). Combat: until the end of your next turn. Test FI to resist.

muddle.name: Muddle
muddle.hint: Your actions gain disadvantage. Combat: until the end of your next turn. Test LO to resist.

pacify.name: Pacify
pacify.hint: You can't perform attack abilities. Combat: until the end of your next turn. Test IN to resist.

poison.name: Poison
poison.hint: Attacks targeting you gain +1 attack. Lasts until you are healed (the heal only removes Poison) or the scene ends. Test CU to resist.

stun.name: Stun
stun.hint: You can't use items or perform any abilities. Combat: until the end of your next turn. Test GR to resist (instead of an action).

wound.name: Wound
wound.hint: Suffer 1 damage at the start of each of your turns (every minute in exploration). Lasts until healed or the scene ends. Test GR to resist.

unconscious.name: Unconscious
unconscious.hint: At 0 HP: you can't act until healed or a Full Rest.

Power.use: Use (post to chat, then expend or lose)

Skill.prepared: In the current loadout (chosen at a Full Rest)
Skill.negate: Lose to negate all damage from one source
Skill.negated: {name} loses {skill} to negate all damage from one source.
Skill.legend: Bookmark = in your loadout (2 ancestry + 4 class, chosen at each Full Rest). Click a name to show it in chat. Expended Skills come back at the end of the scene (Quick Breath), lost ones at a Full Rest.

Grants.title: Granted items
Grants.dropHint: Drop Talents, Skills, perks or other items here, or import a JSON file (e.g. this class's perk file). They are added to a mercenary when this is added to them.
Grants.importHint: Choose a JSON file of items (for example a class perk file). They will be added to this item's grants.
Grants.onlyOne: A mercenary can only have one {type}. Remove the current one first.
Grants.removeConfirm: Also delete the items that {name} granted to this mercenary?

Progression.title: Class & Ancestry
Progression.dropClass: Drag a Class item here (or onto the sheet).
Progression.dropAncestry: Drag an Ancestry item here (or onto the sheet).
Progression.levelHint: Each level: 1 Perk, 1 Attribute point, more HP. Levels 2, 4, 6, 8, 9: a new class Skill. Levels 3 and 7: a passive Talent and an ancestry Skill. Level 5: upgrade active Talents and a new class Skill.

Import.title: Import items
Import.hint: Choose a JSON file of items. Items whose name already exists on this mercenary are skipped.
Import.nothing: This file contains nothing to import here.

Heal.poisonRemoved: {name} is healed: Poison is removed instead of healing damage.

Npc.columnsTitle: Attribute columns (the pair printed above Move and Attack shares their value)
Npc.markersDefense: DFNS markers (what ■ / ▣ mean for this variant)
Npc.markersOffense: OFNS markers (what ✦ / ⊕ mean for this variant)
Npc.summonHint: Drop a mercenary on this sheet to make it their summon (it then draws from their deck).
Npc.printedNemesis: Printed nemesis (table holds final stats; HP and Threat are per mercenary, ×M)

NpcAction.basicHint: Any enemy may instead Move −1 and interact, or Move +0 and start a contest (GR vs GR, CU vs CU, CU vs LO), at any speed.

Threat.label: Threat
Threat.mercenariesHint: Mercenaries present (M). Set it in the system settings, or leave 0 to count player-owned mercenaries.
Threat.clHint: Campaign level: half the average mercenary level, rounded up.
Threat.challengeHint: Combat Challenge table for this CL.
Threat.sceneHint: Hostile NPC tokens with HP on this scene

Element.pending: strong at the end of this turn
Element.hint: Click: infuse · Right-click: consume · GM Shift-click: cycle

Plan.title: Plan the round: {name}
Plan.hint: Choose a primary and a secondary action from two different powers (Talents, ready Skills, items with an action). Your initiative is one of the two powers' initiatives. Skills chosen here are expended (or lost) at the end of your turn, even if you don't use them.
Plan.samePower: The primary and the secondary action must come from two different powers.
Plan.noInitiative: Choose a power with an initiative, or enter one.
Plan.enemiesHint: Choose the initiative speed of each enemy type. A type cannot use the same speed as last round. Elites act before normals of their type.
Plan.noEnemies: No GM-controlled characters in this combat.

Combat.unplanned: These characters haven't planned yet: {names}. Start anyway?
Combat.planningHint: Planning phase: mercenaries choose their actions and initiative, the GM chooses enemy speeds, then the GM starts the action phase.

Damage.noTarget: Select or target a token first.

IconPack.title: Icon pack
IconPack.menuHint: Replace the system's icons (conditions, elements, modifier card faces) with your own, from a JSON manifest in your Foundry data or Forge Assets.
IconPack.hint: Pick an icon pack manifest (iconpack.json). Its paths are relative to the manifest. The page reloads after a change.

Content.title: Import content
Content.menuHint: Build world compendiums (classes, ancestries, Backgrounds, bestiary) from your own content folder's index.json, and load its icon pack.
Content.hint: Pick the index.json of your content folder (Foundry data or Forge Assets). Existing Gloomhaven compendiums are emptied and filled again. If the index names an icon pack, it is loaded and the page reloads.

Creation.title: Create a mercenary

hint.identity: Name your mercenary. Click the portrait to choose an image.
hint.ancestry: Your ancestry sets your origins and gives you its Level 1 Skills.
hint.class: Your class gives you Attribute points, a health track, its Talents and Level 1 Skills, and its perks.
hint.faction: Your faction is the organization you owe allegiance to. You start at
hint.attributes: After your class's points, distribute 6 points among the six Attributes. No Attribute may go above 3.
hint.backgrounds: Choose 4 Backgrounds. The usual choice is 1 occupation, 1 origin and 2 social, but any mix is allowed. Master occupations are earned through play.
hint.inventory: Take your class's starting gear, or buy 50 g worth of common gear. Your weapons and basic equipment are assumed and need no item.
hint.quest: A goal that, once completed, lets your mercenary retire. Make it big and personal.

Creation.noFactions: No factions found in your items or compendiums. You can skip this step.
